records.title: Focus on the Core: Efficient Attention via Pruned Token Compression for Document Classification
records.reason: Experiments on BERT-style document classification report token pruning/combining and lower time/memory, but do not establish LLM generation or serving behavior; retain as a sparse-attention lineage lead.

records.title: A Survey on Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models
records.reason: This is a taxonomy and survey of agentic multimodal LLM concepts, not a new inference algorithm or measured serving improvement. Its relationship to MoE-LLaVA is at the broad multimodal-model level, without a concrete efficiency method that could be evaluated as an inference contribution.

records.title: Critical attention scaling in long-context transformers
records.reason: The paper derives a theoretical transition in attention behavior with context length; it analyzes scaling but does not provide a serving optimization or resource reduction. Keep as weak long-context lineage research.

records.title: TR2-D2: Tree Search Guided Trajectory-Aware Fine-Tuning for Discrete Diffusion
records.reason: The paper uses tree-search replay and trajectory-aware fine-tuning to optimize reward quality for discrete-diffusion generation. Although the model family overlaps diffusion language generation, the contribution is post-training/model-quality optimization and reports no inference-step, latency, throughput, or memory reduction.

records.title: RLRC: Reinforcement Learning-Based Recovery for Compressed Vision-Language-Action Models
records.reason: RLRC reports pruning/quantization, up to 8x memory reduction and 2.3x inference speedup, but its evaluated system is a vision-language-action robot policy whose objective and action-generation stack are VLA-specific. It is adjacent to the cited LLM quantization lineage, so retained as borderline for possible transfer; the paper does not establish an LLM text-serving result.
